product.title: Complete Island 60-Minute Helicopter Tour

description.text: Maui is an island that’s best seen by air, and on this complete island Maui helicopter tour, visitors soar above valleys and waterfalls that are otherwise inaccessible. Fly deep inside the West Maui Mountains where there aren’t even any trails, and gaze upon the colorful cinder cones of Haleakala Crater. Stops include Haleakala Crater, Hana Highway - Road to Hana, West Maui Mountains. Off the coast of Hana, watch as waterfalls tumble their way directly into the sea, and see hidden coves and white sand beaches you never even knew were there. Ideal for visitors basing on Maui who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
